verdict.rationale: The evidence documents publishing and deployment only through the web hosting flow (connect a GitHub repo, or ship a Dockerfile/npm/PyPI artifact) and a REST directory API. Agent installation is done by copy-pasting JSON config blocks. No official Glama CLI for authenticating, building, pushing, or installing servers appears anywhere; mcp-proxy is only a tunnel for exposing local servers to the inspector, so it is an adjacent tool, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents
